title: Dialectica Wins Two Bronze Awards at DevOps & Agile Awards 2024
summary: Dialectica won two bronze awards: Best Use of AIOps/MLOps Tool in DevOps for its GenAI-powered automated transcription system (90% success rate), and Best Use of Microservices/Containers for its monolith-to-microservices migration that yielded a 35% increase in customer satisfaction.
